choices: A local history of where HEAD and branch tips have moved
Every file on your hard disk
items.explain: Reflog records local HEAD/branch movements—commits, checkouts, resets—even when log forgets a commit.

items.prompt: After git reset --hard HEAD~1, a common undo is…
items.explain: HEAD@{1} is the previous reflog position—often the tip before the reset.

items.prompt: Reflog entries are automatically shared when you git push.
items.explain: Reflog is local to your clone; push recovery branches if others need the commit.

items.prompt: A commit can disappear from git log but still appear in reflog when…
choices: No branch points at it anymore after a hard reset
items.explain: Hard reset can drop the branch tip; reflog may still reference the old commit hash.
